name: Liquidity-matched narrative pair
hypothesis: Trade a preregistered stable spread only after a deviation begins reverting and both legs meet capacity limits.
spec: Setup: Two economically similar tokens may diverge temporarily. Entry: Trade a preregistered stable spread only after a deviation begins reverting and both legs meet capacity limits. Evaluate only information available at decision time; attempt execution afterward. Exit: Exit at spread target or relationship-break stop. Always apply the earlier of the registered maximum holding time and hard risk invalidation; fills can be delayed or unavailable. Parameters to pre-register: eligible universe and point-in-time membership, observation window and completed-event/bar rule, numerical threshold(s) named by the signal, entry order and maximum price/quote deviation, initial invalidation level and target if used, H_max and explicit session definition, cost, impact, latency, failed-attempt, and leg-risk models, position/notional/exit-capacity caps, baseline and out-of-sample rejection thresholds.
blocked_reason: needs hedgeable short legs or float estimates for memecoins
